description: Daybreak LaunchPad for PlanetSide 2: installs, patches and starts the game without Steam.
notes: Not portable: runs Daybreak's installer (it also installs the VC++ runtimes and the DirectX web setup).
Install, update and uninstall from an elevated (admin) shell; the installer opens its own wizard,
where you can pick the game folder (default C:\Users\Public\Daybreak Game Company\Installed Games\PlanetSide 2).
LaunchPad downloads the game (tens of GB) after you log in, and keeps itself and the game up to date.
The package version is the date Daybreak published PS2_setup.exe; 'scoop update' reruns the installer,
which finds the existing copy and offers Reinstall / Repair.
Stops if PlanetSide 2 is installed in Steam (that is the PlanetSide-2 package), or if a standalone copy
was installed without Scoop; to let Scoop take over that copy, run $env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'The PlanetSide 2 installer needs admin rights: run this from an elevated shell.'; break }

$standalone = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like 'DGC-PlanetSide 2*' -or $_.PSChildName -eq 'PlanetSide 2' } | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.InstallLocation)$($_.UninstallString)" -notlike '*\steamapps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($inSteam) { error 'PlanetSide 2 is installed in Steam; use that copy (package PlanetSide-2) or remove it in Steam first, so there is only one copy of the game.'; break }
# A fresh 'scoop install' must not silently take over a copy installed without Scoop; 'scoop update' is not affected.
error "$($standalone.DisplayName) is already installed on this system. Uninstall it first, or run `$env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again to let Scoop manage it from now on."

script: Write-Host 'Finish the PlanetSide 2 setup wizard that opens now.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
if ($setup.ExitCode -ne 0) { error "PlanetSide 2 setup exited with code $($setup.ExitCode) (1 or 2: cancelled or aborted)."; break }
if (!(is_admin)) { error 'The PlanetSide 2 uninstaller needs admin rights: run this from an elevated shell.'; break }
# On update the installer repairs the existing copy; only a real uninstall removes the game.

$standalone = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like 'DGC-PlanetSide 2*' -or $_.PSChildName -eq 'PlanetSide 2' } | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.InstallLocation)$($_.UninstallString)" -notlike '*\steamapps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (!$standalone) { warn 'The standalone PlanetSide 2 was not found among installed programs; nothing to remove.'; return }
Write-Host 'The PlanetSide 2 uninstaller has opened; finish it there.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
# The download URL has no version; use the date Daybreak published the file.
